purpose: ONE clean master joining all mined/saved assets (measurement instrument, carded datasets, competitor landscape, contacts, axes) into the master monorepo, keyed + connected + no-duplicate. Sources cited; no invented counters. This is the single registry that joins everything into us.

banks.purpose: the frozen GSPC probe banks each axis is measured against

carded_datasets.note: 25 mined datasets carded; 20 green = signatures verified

our_moat: unsolicited + permissionless (no issuer opt-in/payment) + statistically-governed (Wilson/separation/McNemar) + cryptographically signed — no incumbent offers that combination

honest_measurements.rule: JL.5 — a thing is MEASURED only when its signed card exists with a frozen, hash-pinned bank. UNMEASURED candidates are NOT flipped to measured by assertion; they become measured when measured + signed.

no_duplicate_rule: Every asset here is keyed + source-cited. Before adding anything new, check this master + COORDINATION_DB.json + the honest register; update in place, never create a parallel copy. Audit before publish (harness/AUDIT.md).
